mn19:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn19:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn19:2.1: Pubbe va me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass' eva sato etad-ahosi:
mn19:2.2: Yan-nūnāhaṃ dvidhā katvā dvidhā katvā vitakke vihareyyan-ti.
mn19:2.3: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave yo cāyaṃ kāmavitakko yo ca byāpādavitakko yo ca vihiṃsāvitakko
mn19:2.5: yo cāyaṃ nekkhammavitakko yo ca abyāpādavitakko yo ca avihiṃsāvitakko
mn19:3.1: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave evaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati kāmavitakko, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn19:3.4: so ca kho attabyābādhāya pi saṃvattati, parabyābādhāya pi saṃvattati, ubhayabyābādhāya pi saṃvattati, paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
mn19:3.5: Attabyābādhāya saṃvattatīti pi me bhikkhave paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati,
mn19:3.6: parabyābādhāya saṃvattatīti pi me bhikkhave paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati,
mn19:3.7: ubhayabyābādhāya saṃvattatīti pi me bhikkhave paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati,
mn19:3.8: paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko ti pi me bhikkhave paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati.
mn19:3.9: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave uppannuppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ pajahām' eva vinodem' eva, byant' eva naṃ akāsiṃ.
mn19:4-5.1: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave evaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati byāpādavitakko --pe--
mn19:4-5.9: anibbānasaṃvattaniko ti pi me bhikkhave paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati.
mn19:4-5.10: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave uppannuppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ pajahām' eva vinodem' eva, byant' eva naṃ akāsiṃ.
mn19:6.1: Yañ-ñad-eva bhikkhave bhikkhu bahulam-anuvitakketi anuvicāreti tathā tathā nati hoti cetaso.
mn19:6.2: Kāmavitakkaṃ ce bhikkhave bhikkhu bahulam-anuvitakketi anuvicāreti, pahāsi nekkhammavitakkaṃ, kāmavitakkaṃ bahulamakāsi, tassa taṃ kāmavitakkāya cittaṃ namati.
mn19:6.4: ce bhikkhave bhikkhu bahulam-anuvitakketi anuvicāreti, pahāsi avihiṃsāvitakkaṃ, vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ bahulam-akāsi, tassa taṃ vihiṃsāvitakkāya cittaṃ namati.
mn19:7.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye kiṭṭhasambādhe gopālako gāvo rakkheyya,
mn19:7.2: so tā gāvo tato tato daṇḍena ākoṭeyya patikoṭeyya sannirundheyya sannivāreyya,
mn19:7.4: passati hi so bhikkhave gopālako tatonidānaṃ vadhaṃ vā bandhaṃ vā jāniṃ vā garahaṃ vā;
mn19:7.5: evam-eva kho ahaṃ bhikkhave addasaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ vodānapakkhaṃ.
mn19:8.1: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave evaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato upajjati nekkhammavitakko,
mn19:8.4: so ca kho n' ev' attabyābādhāya saṃvattati, na parabyābādhāya saṃvattati, na ubhayabyābādhāya saṃvattati, paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko.
mn19:8.5: Rattiñ-ce pi naṃ bhikkhave anuvitakkeyyaṃ anuvicāreyyaṃ n' eva tatonidānaṃ bhayaṃ samanupassāmi,
mn19:8.6: divasañ-ce pi naṃ bhikkhave anuvitakkeyyaṃ anuvicāreyyaṃ n' eva tatonidānaṃ bhayaṃ samanupassāmi,
mn19:8.7: rattindivañ-ce pi naṃ bhikkhave anuvitakkeyyaṃ anuvicāreyyaṃ n' eva tatonidānaṃ bhayaṃ samanupassāmi.
mn19:8.8: Api ca kho me aticiraṃ anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato kāyo kilameyya,
mn19:8.10: ūhate citte ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā ti.
mn19:8.11: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave ajjhattam-eva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisādemi ekodikaromi samādahāmi,
mn19:9-10.1: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave evaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati abyāpādāvitakko --pe--
mn19:9-10.5: so ca kho n' ev' attabyābādhāya saṃvattati, na parabyābādhāya saṃvattati, na ubhayabyābādhāya saṃvattati, paññāvuddhiko avighātapakkhiko nibbānasaṃvattaniko.
mn19:9-10.9: Api ca kho me aticiraṃ anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato kāyo kilameyya,
mn19:9-10.11: ūhate citte ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā ti.
mn19:9-10.12: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave ajjhattam-eva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisādemi ekodikaromi samādahāmi,
mn19:11.1: Yaññad-eva bhikkhave bhikkhu bahulam-anuvitakketi anuvicāreti tathā tathā nati hoti cetaso.
mn19:11.2: Nekkhammavitakkaṃ ce bhikkhave bhikkhu bahulam-anuvitakketi anuvicāreti, pahāsi kāmavitakkaṃ, nekkhammavitakkaṃ bahulam-akāsi, tassa taṃ nekkhammavitakkāya cittaṃ namati.
mn19:11.4: ce bhikkhave bhikkhu bahulam-anuvitakketi anuvicāreti, pahāsi vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ, avihiṃsāvitakkaṃ bahulam-akāsi, tassa taṃ avihiṃsāvitakkāya cittaṃ namati.
mn19:12.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave gimhānaṃ pacchime māse sabbasassesu gāmantasambhatesu gopālako gāvo rakkheyya, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ tassa rukkhamūlagatassa vā abbhokāsagatassa vā satikaraṇīyam-eva hoti:
mn19:13.1: Āraddhaṃ kho pana me bhikkhave viriyaṃ ahosi asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ.
mn19:14.1: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn19:15.1: Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn19:16.1: Pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca vihāsiṃ sato ca sampajāno, sukhañ-ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedesiṃ yan-taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekhako satimā sukhavihārī ti tatiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn19:17.1: Sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn19:24.1: Ayaṃ kho me bhikkhave rattiyā pacchime yāme tatiyā vijjā adhigatā,
mn19:24.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato āloko uppanno, yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
mn19:25.1: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave araññe pavane mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalaṃ,
mn19:25.3: tassa kocid-eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo,
mn19:25.4: so yvāssa maggo khemo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo taṃ maggaṃ pidaheyya, vivareyya kummaggaṃ, odaheyya okacaraṃ, ṭhapeyya okacārikaṃ;
mn19:25.5: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave mahā migasaṅgho aparena samayena anayabyasanaṃ tanuttaṃ āpajjeyya.
mn19:25.6: Tass' eva kho pana bhikkhave mahato migasaṅghassa kocid-eva puriso uppajjeyya atthakāmo hitakāmo-yogakkhemakāmo,
mn19:25.7: so yvāssa maggo khemo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo taṃ maggaṃ vivareyya, pidaheyya kummaggaṃ, ūhaneyya okacaraṃ, nāseyya okacārikaṃ;
mn19:25.8: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave mahā migasaṅgho aparena samayena vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
mn19:26.1: Upamā kho me ayaṃ bhikkhave katā atthassa viññāpanāya, \ [...
mn19:26.2: content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ ayañ-c' ev' ettha attho:
mn19:26.3: Mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalan-ti kho bhikkhave kāmānam-etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn19:26.4: Mahā migasaṅgho ti kho bhikkhave sattānam-etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn19:26.5: Puriso anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo ti kho bhikkhave Mārass' etaṃ pāpimato adhivacanaṃ.
mn19:26.6: Kummaggo ti kho bhikkhave aṭṭhaṅgikass' etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
mn19:26.7: micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākammantassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.
mn19:26.8: Okacaro ti kho bhikkhave nandirāgass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn19:26.9: Okacārikā ti kho bhikkhave avijjāy' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn19:26.10: Puriso atthakāmo hitakāmo yogakkhemakāmo ti kho bhikkhave Tathāgatass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
mn19:26.11: Khemo maggo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo ti kho bhikkhave ariyass' etaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ:
mn19:26.12: sammādiṭṭhiyā sammāsaṅkappassa sammāvācāya sammākammantassa sammāājīvassa sammāvāyāmassa sammāsatiyā sammāsamādhissa.
mn19:26.13: Iti kho bhikkhave vivaṭo mayā khemo maggo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo, pihito kummaggo, ūhato okacaro, nāsitā okacārikā.
mn19:27.1: Yaṃ bhikkhave satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
mn19:27.2: Etāni bhikkhave rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni. Jhāyatha bhikkhave, mā pamādattha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha; ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī ti.
mn19:27.4: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun- ti. 20.
